reference.weighting: One equal vote per current eligible NBA player; 50/50 home-away. Neutral opponent is the arithmetic mean of the 30 deduplicated team strength snapshots.
reference.held_fixed: Same player form, expected minutes, own-team context and issue-date availability. Opponent rest fixed at 2 days/no back-to-back/2 games in prior4 days, H2H fixed at zero in both alternatives. No future outcome or actual target-game minutes.
reference.interpretation: Standardized conditional FP contrast of the existing Ridge matchup component. It is not a causal defense rating or a separately validated calendar score.

residual_method.prior_choice: The larger of the two preregistered priors, used for descriptive display only; no winning positional predictor was selected.
residual_method.adjustment: Played-game residual versus monthly prequential Ridge historically and immutable near Ridge in current season; subtract opponent and position marginal means and add back global mean, then shrink interaction toward zero.

position_mapping.workbook_clock_note: Core created timestamps are workbook metadata, not independently verified acquisition timestamps; some are ahead of observed UTC time. Use observed_at_utc for information availability.

limitations: Position labels are retrospective seasonal exports, not historically frozen pregame positions.
Current-season outcomes only update a descriptive state; no fitting, selection or forecast calibration used them.
Effect uncertainty is approximate and conditional on the selected model, mapping and source quality; it is not a calibrated match or multi-game FP range.
The adjusted residual is not causal defensive ability and still contains unexpected minutes and role changes.
Forecasts and KEEP/NOW/LATER must not multiply by or add these displayed descriptive position effects.
